Liberation War: Make law to punish those who speak against it
2023-04-10T00:00:00+06:00 | Staff Correspondent
https://www.thedailystar.net/news/bangladesh/news/liberation-war-make-law-punish-those-who-speak-against-it-3293151

Liberation War Affairs Minister AKM Mozammel Huq in parliament yesterday sought a new law enabling the government to take action against those who speak against the Liberation War and the spirit of independence.

While speaking during a discussion on a motion on the golden jubilee of the Jatiya Sangsad, the minister said if there is no opportunity to take legal action against those who lie, distort history, oppose freedom, the state may be under threat.

Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina on Friday placed the motion in the House on the 50th anniversary of parliament.

In his speech, Mozammel said, "There should be new laws so that action can be taken against those who lie and oppose freedom.

"I have heard that the Law Commission has proposed such a law. I will call for this law to be passed in this parliament to keep the nation protected."

Pointing to the BNP, the minister said they tried to question the last two elections to make parliament ineffective. They are plotting to make Bangladesh a dysfunctional and failed state.

"Since Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina had people involved in jail killings and Bangabandhu murder prosecuted, she can have this law enacted to punish the anti-state and anti-independence elements of the country," he added.
